summary: The new contract, long held by Republic Services subsidiary Rabanco, is meant to help fetch better commodities prices and divert more material from disposal, Seattle Public Utilities said.

title: Rhode Island food waste reduction and recycling network gains momentum
summary: The state’s disposal ban still isn’t being enforced 10 years later, but advocates are getting traction on new policy ideas including a recently signed school food waste reduction bill.

title: 4 EPR takeaways from the Packaging Recycling Summit
summary: Brands, local governments and nonprofit organizations discussed extended producer responsibility compliance tensions and solutions during the conference from June 15-17.

title: Senate releases farm bill draft omitting some food waste provisions
summary: The draft is missing some aspects included in the House version of the five-year funding bill for the U.S. Department of Agriculture, including for food loss research. But there are still certain benefits for organics recycling.

title: Republic Services to acquire hazardous waste assets from TD*X in Texas
summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission approved the deal, which would expand Republic Services’ operations at a facility near Corpus Christi, Texas.

title: 17 Republican AGs suing over California packaging EPR law
summary: Less than a month out from a trial in Oregon, the National Association of Wholesaler-Distributors says it’s joining this California lawsuit as the sole business plaintiff.

title: MRF upgrades in California, Minnesota, Ontario leverage grants and EPR
summary: Recent updates from WM in Ontario, Mid-Valley Recycling in California and Olmsted County in Minnesota aim to improve capacity and quality.

title: Garbage to Garden expands into Maine waste, recycling collection market
summary: The composter is starting its second municipal waste hauling contract that was previously serviced by Casella. President Tyler Frank shares expansion plans and why he doesn’t view this as a change of the company’s mission.
